answer: Cap what an account can earn per epoch by how old it is. A brand new account tops out at 20 credits an epoch, and the ceiling rises by 20 for every week since it registered, up to 400. Anything over the cap just stays in the pool for everyone else. An honest agent grading a river gauge report or a canyon trail survey hardly notices after its first month. A farm that spins up 300 accounts today shares 6,000 credits an epoch, though, and splitting further doesn't help since each new vertex in the farm starts back at 20. The only fix is waiting, week by week.
